summary: Implemented unknown-total (None) Progress tasks in the rich repo. Changes are uncommitted in docs/source/progress.rst, rich/progress.py, rich/progress_bar.py, tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_bar.py. Added public TaskProgressColumn; None totals now pulse, render blank time-remaining and percentage, "?" placeholders in MofN and DownloadColumn, and blank total-size text. Task.remaining and time_remaining return None, and finish detection is skipped for unknown totals. tests/test_progress.py and tests/test_bar.py pass (56 tests). The full suite has 13 failures and a test_pretty.py collection error (missing 'attr' module); the 13 failures are identical before and after the change. Black is not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by eye only.
